message: ジョーズ≠鮫
The first day of exams ended.
Without either of us suggesting it, Misa and I turned the Student Council room into a study hall again today to cram for tests.
Strictly speaking, it goes against the room's intended purpose, but a small perk like this should be forgivable.

name: Paqy
message: 「Ain't it fine? Ria-chan gave us secret permission, you know? Nom nom」
Seeming to have read my mind, Paqy backs me up.

name: Misa
message: 「Paqy-san, what are you eating?」

name: Synn
message: 「Isn't that kashiwa mochi? When did you buy it?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Good grief, neither of you noticed?」

name: Paqy
message: 「About two hours ago, Ria-chan came to check on us and left them as a treat.」

name: Paqy
message: 「D-Darn it! If I'd kept my mouth shut, all three would've been all mine!」

name: Misa
message: 「Didn't Big Sister tell you they were one per person, Paqy-san?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Y-You already knew, hiss?」

name: Misa
message: 「No. Still, I know at least that much about someone I love.」

name: Misa
message: 「So you break the orders of the woman you love, Paqy-san......」

name: Paqy
message: 「H-Heh heh heh...... Of course it was just a joke, okay?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Instead of burying your noses in books non-stop, how 'bout taking a breather right about now, you two?」

name: Synn
message: 「Good idea, then I'll brew some tea--」

name: Misa
message: 「Wait!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun, you were planning on making Japanese tea or coffee, weren't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, that goes better with Japanese sweets, after all.」

name: Misa
message: 「Stay seated! I will brew black tea!」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What's with that dissatisfied response!? Depending on how you brew it, black tea can bring out the flavor of Japanese sweets too, you know!」

name: Misa
message: 「Y-You're doubting me, aren't you? Just watch, it's a contest! I'll make you eat your words!」
While Misa was brewing the black tea, the sun had already set.
Strangely enough, during exam periods, demon activity falls into a lull--almost as if the demons are busy writing test questions, proctoring exams, and grading answer sheets.

name: Synn
message: 「Sip... munch, munch」

name: Misa
message: 「Munch, munch」

name: Synn
message: 「Gulp, sip...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. That was good tea.」

name: Synn
message: 「The kashiwamochi was delicious too. Is this a specialty from Hanamura?」

name: Misa
message: 「Mmph...」

name: Misa
message: 「...Grrr!」

name: Synn
message: 「Haha, I am thoroughly impressed. In my ignorance, I had no idea strong black tea paired so well with Japanese sweets.」

name: Misa
message: 「As long as you understand!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph, that makes me the winner, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「...Misa, let's decide who cleans up with rock-paper-scissors.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm going to throw scissors.」

name: Synn
message: 「Rock, paper, scissors, shoot!」

name: Misa
message: 「Sh-Shoot!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Lord Synn showed his hand, so why did Hisa throw paper?」

name: Misa
message: 「Gyaaaah!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, there's only one day of exams left tomorrow. Let's get back to studying」

name: Misa
message: 「I suppose I have no choice, since everyone's in danger on this exam. I'll humor you a little longer」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah!? W-Wait a second!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Because you were being weirdly stubborn, Sakura-kun, we couldn't chat during teatime, remember?」

name: Misa
message: 「So let's do it now. While studying properly!」

name: Synn
message: 「When it comes to stubbornness, you're pretty impressive yourself, Misa...」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What's that supposed to mean! It's your fault, Sakura-kun!」

name: Misa
message: 「If you don't take first place on this exam...」

name: Synn
message: 「You'd be thrilled, Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「Only if I'm first and you're second, Sakura-kun...」

name: Misa
message: 「Or else, like usual, you take top spot and I'm runner-up... I won't accept any other outcome」

name: Misa
message: 「If anyone else squeezes in between us, it'll ruin our rivalry!」
If that's the case, we wouldn't need to be first and second. Even 251st and 252nd would be fine by that logic.
Though if I actually said that out loud, Misa would definitely scold me.

name: Misa
message: 「Got it!? Sakura-kun!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah, so you stayed with me this late just so I could get a good score」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks. Even though you're scared of the dark, Misa」

name: Misa
message: 「T-There's no way that's true!」

name: Misa
message: 「B-But... well, just a little... I guess you could say it makes me uneasy...」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「You see, pretty early on, I begged Mother and Father to give me my own room」

name: Synn
message: 「I see」
Misa doesn't say anything more, simply gazing straight into my eyes.
Anyone who knows even the slightest bit about Misa could figure out why.
Not wanting to worry her busy parents who always came home late, Misa must have asked for a room of her own.
And her wish was granted right away.
Of course, after coming home, her parents must have quietly opened the door to the children's room and looked at young Misa's sleeping face.
And they felt relieved.
But what about Misa back then?
It takes days for a person to become able to sleep all alone, going through all sorts of feelings along the way.
Though just a little child, Misa accomplished that faster than anyone else.

name: Misa
message: 「...Still, that's why ordinary nights don't bother me at all.」

name: Misa
message: 「Because I experienced the scariest night of all when I was little, nights crawling with Demons are nothing to me.」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hmph, have you ever experienced a night like that, Sakura-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「For me, the night I slept with my dad when I was a kid was the scariest one ever.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, Sakura-kun! That's just awful! Take that back!」

name: Synn
message: 「No way. You don't understand the terror I went through, Misa.」

name: Misa
message: 「Saying it was scary sleeping next to your father, that's... that's just...!」

name: Synn
message: 「I mean, Dad kept humming that melody of a man-eating shark closing in while pressing his prickly, stubbly cheek against me all night long, you know?」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「I think it was probably because I was being rowdy and wouldn't go to sleep, though.」

name: Misa
message: 「Then wasn't that your own fault?」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Oh, was it really?」

name: Misa
message: 「Giggle... You really are such a dummy.」
Past the final dismissal time, we leave school practically chased out by the security guard.

name: Paqy
message: 「Zzz... zzz...」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy's fast asleep. It's gotten pretty late, hasn't it?」

name: Misa
message: 「It has. I'm totally fine, though?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I'm fine too.」

name: Misa
message: 「W-Why are you doing warm-up stretches too?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Isn't it obvious? Because we're about to run.」

name: Misa
message: 「N-No way...!?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm walking you home!」

name: Misa
message: 「No way!」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey! Stop following me!」

name: Synn
message: 「You said you don't like dark places, didn't you?」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I already forgot about that!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Why are you coming through a place like this? It's not the way you usually go home, is it?」

name: Misa
message: 「Sh-Shut up, this way is a shortcut!」

name: Synn
message: 「Aren't you trying to lose me?」

name: Misa
message: 「G-Gah!?」

name: Synn
message: 「You're totally unathletic, so where did that speed come from?」

name: Misa
message: 「Running away from you is the one time I can sprint like my life depends on it, Sakura-kun!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Is it really worth risking your life over!?」

name: Synn
message: 「We're right back where we started. That ended up being a detour after all.」

name: Misa
message: 「If you're going to complain, just go home! Running around glued to my side is pathetic!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then we can just walk side by side. That'd look completely normal.」

name: Misa
message: 「I refuse! Like I'd ever walk with you, Sakura-kun!!」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Huh?」
Beyond the streetlight, Misa's figure--which had been dashing lightly without even losing her breath--suddenly vanishes.

name: Synn
message: 「An alley!? Darn it, I lost sight of her...!」
This neighborhood has an especially high concentration of upscale homes for Ryuusei Town. Even in an all-out game of tag, Misa has the home-turf advantage here.

name: Synn
message: 「Hnnnnnnh--」

name: Synn
message: 「Miiiiii--saaaaa--! Gooooood--niiiiiiight--!!」

name: Misa's Voice
message: 「Don't yell your goodbyes at the top of your lungs, it's embarrassing! What if the neighbors hear you!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Oh, they definitely heard you loud and clear.」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy, you're already awake?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Anyone'd wake up after being jostled around while running, and then screamed at to top it off.」

name: Paqy
message: 「With that kind of power, Hiss'll be safe even on the streets at night. Besides, this neighborhood is classy and safe.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Instead of forcing it, it's better to wait until Hiss invites you on their own, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, true. But tonight I just felt like running.」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's 'cause you're happy too, Demon Lord, just like Hiss.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that how I am? Hmm, hmm...?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Tomorrow's the last day of exams, right? Stop overthinking things and just get to sleep already.」

name: Synn
message: 「You've got a point.」
